snippet.title: 🧀 Mouse Mouse, Climb the House - TRAILER 🧀
snippet.description:
Cheese cheese cheese, I need my CHEESE!  🧀
Play it here: https://pelicanparty.games/mouse

Mouse mouse, Climb the house, the latest web game from Pelican Party Studios. 


Mouse Mouse: Climb the House
is multiplayer obstacle game where you are a tiny little mischievous mouse on a quest for..... 🧀 Climb on shelves, leap across furniture, dive into the fridge, launch from a toaster and dodge traps in a house filled with challenges and surprises.

As you navigate through the house, you’ll face increasingly elaborate traps set by the homeowner who’s determined to protect his precious cheese. Each level brings new obstacles and that test your agility.

How to play Mouse Mouse, Climb the House?
Go to: https://pelicanparty.games/mouse
Move: WASD or the arrow keys
Jump: the space bar
Camera: use your mouse to look around
Mouse Mouse, Climb the House can be played on your computer and mobile devices like phones and tablets.



Feel free to join our Discord to tells us about your feedback:
https://discord.gg/PhwWYkzfEw

Mouse Mouse climb the house is developed by Pelican Party Studios   
Pelicanparty.co - 2024
